label: Independence Day
description: A respectful, modern Indian tricolor-inspired theme with saffron, white, green, and navy accents.

style.visualDirection: Professional dark interface with measured tricolor accents and subtle navy details.
style.shadows: Neutral shadows; avoid strong colored glow.
style.borders: Neutral borders with restrained saffron or green accents for selected states.

decorations.placement: A thin decorative ribbon near the hero edge or footer; never behind body text.
decorations.animation: Optional slow wave or static SVG.

decorations.placement: Soft background glow in empty hero or banner areas.
Small, tasteful watermark in an open background area when appropriate.
Optional, limited to a brief celebratory hero effect.
decorations.animation: Short and non-looping; disabled under reduced motion.

art.assetStyle: Geometric SVGs and restrained Indian tricolor accents; use official symbols respectfully and accurately.
avoid: Distorting the Indian flag or Ashoka Chakra
Using the flag as a floor, background texture behind text, or an arbitrary card fill
Excessive confetti, fireworks, or patriotic imagery that overwhelms the club identity

motion.reducedMotion: Use static gradients and ornaments; disable confetti and wave motion.
